messages:
rita_cs: RiotPay (acct RP-11) onboarding hit preflight 429s during heavy QA runs. GA in 5 days. Can we triage?

ben_eng: Are these preflight calls from mobile coldstarts or server-side? Any logs?

rita_cs: Mobile coldstart, about 10 parallel preflight requests per device. Sample log: 
```
2026-03-23T02:10:05Z GET /v1/preflight 429 X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 window=60
client: mobile-js/0.9.2 region: eu-central-1 X-Client-Time=2026-03-23T02:09:49Z
```

mobile_support: Looks like clock skew (~16s behind) plus no coalescing across RN bridge. Two quick mitigations: patch client to use server-time fallback and share a single inflight preflight promise on init.

ben_eng: Also recommend jittered backoff. Example snippet to share with customer: 
```
let inflight = null
function preflight() {
  if (inflight) return inflight
  inflight = fetch('/v1/preflight').finally(() => { inflight = null })
  return inflight
}
const backoff = i => Math.min(900 * 2**i + Math.random()*200, 9000)
```

ops: We can enable temporary onboarding-mode for RP-11: preflight quota x3 and edge coalescing for 48h. Need approval to flip.

rita_cs: Please enable. I told customer to prepare patch; their release takes ~24h.

ops: Onboarding-mode enabled for RP-11 until 2026-03-25T02:10:00Z. Monitoring 1m/5m error rates.

docs-bot: Created ticket CS-1402: "quickstart: mobile preflight troubleshooting + shared promise sample" assigned to ben_eng/docs.

rita_cs: Add to account health: renewal risk if GA misses. Keep me posted.

ben_eng: Will update quickstart with "preflight gotchas" and header checks (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-Server-Time) and link to CS-1402.

rita_cs: Thanks team. I'll confirm once customer rolls patch. :thumbsup:
